Portrait of Yuan Yonglin

Yuan Yonglin appears in a serene outdoor portrait, standing against a backdrop of lush greenery. She wears a light trench coat layered over a blue top, and her hair features subtle pink highlights at the ends. Her hands are gently clasped in front of her face, conveying a calm and contemplative mood.

Born Wu Xinyun in Houston, Texas, on November 14, 1986, Yuan Yonglin began studying piano at age four and violin at nine.
